Hi, I'm **Yash Pratap Singh**. I build systems that sit at the intersection of
computer vision and medical/edge AI, and I compete on LeetCode when a problem
needs solving fast instead of slow.

- B.Tech Computer Science (AI-ML) @ VIT Bhopal — CGPA 9.04, Class of 2027
- Software Engineering Intern @ **ShotSelect** (May–Jul 2026) — cross-platform
  desktop app with React, TypeScript, Electron, Cloudflare Workers
- Currently building **PulmoScan** (medical CV) and refining real-time edge
  vision pipelines
- Fun fact: **most of my projects start as "can this actually run in real time?"**
